cases.name: reexport-individual
cases.claim: An individually imported name cannot be re-exported; fails with "Cannot export unknown type Thing".

cases.name: reexport-individual-control
cases.claim: Control: the same facade re-exporting the whole module with `module X` compiles.

cases.name: facade-hides-ctor
cases.claim: A whole-module re-export carries exactly what the facade imported; `import Money (Cents(..))` then `Cents 1` gets "Unknown data constructor Cents".

cases.name: facade-hides-ctor-control
cases.claim: Control: the same caller importing `Cents(..)` from the submodule, not the facade, compiles.

cases.name: facade-keeps-type-and-fn
cases.claim: Callers of the facade get the type `Cents` and the function `fromInt`.

cases.name: export-forms
cases.claim: Export forms: `T` exports the type alone, `T(..)` every constructor, and a list naming every constructor is accepted.

cases.name: export-forms-hidden
cases.claim: Export forms: a constructor list that leaves one out, `V(A)` for `data V = A | B`, is rejected with TransitiveDctorExportError.

cases.name: purs-graph-json
cases.claim: `purs graph` prints the import graph as JSON.

cases.name: cycle-point-free
cases.claim: A point-free definition inside a recursive binding group is a CycleInDeclaration; the error names `one`, while the culprit is `go`.

includes: The value of one is undefined here, so this reference is not allowed.

cases.name: cycle-fixed
cases.claim: The fix `go es = concatMap one es` compiles.

cases.name: cycle-nonrecursive
cases.claim: The same point-free definition compiles until the group becomes recursive.

cases.name: orphan-instance
cases.claim: No orphan instances: `instance Eq Price` outside the class's and the type's module fails with OrphanInstance.

cases.name: orphan-instance-control
cases.claim: Control: the same instance in the type's module compiles.

cases.name: newtype-derive-inner
cases.claim: `derive newtype instance Eq Price` over `Cents` with no `Eq` fails with "No type class instance was found for Eq Cents".

includes: No type class instance was found for

cases.name: newtype-derive-inner-control
cases.claim: Control: once `Cents` has `Eq`, the derive compiles.

cases.name: generic-hidden-ctor
cases.claim: `Generic` on a hidden constructor draws a HiddenConstructors warning, not an error.

cases.name: constrained-ctor
cases.claim: Constrained data constructors do not exist: `data Range a = Ord a => Range a a` fails to parse with "Unexpected token '=>'".

cases.name: constrained-ctor-control
cases.claim: Control: `data Range a = Range a a` parses.

cases.name: semigroup-number
cases.claim: `Number` has no Semigroup: deriving through a newtype fails with "No type class instance was found for Semigroup Number".

cases.name: semigroup-int
cases.claim: `Int` has no Semigroup either.

cases.name: additive-wrapper
cases.claim: Wrapping the value in `Data.Monoid.Additive` gives Semigroup and Monoid.

cases.name: semiring-four-members
cases.claim: `Semiring` is four operations, not one: an instance with only `add` and `zero` is incomplete.

cases.name: semiring-four-members-control
cases.claim: Control: the instance with `add`, `zero`, `mul` and `one` compiles.

cases.name: between-explicit
cases.claim: `between` is in Prelude; an explicit import `import Ranges (between)` shadows it with a ScopeShadowing warning.

cases.name: between-open
cases.claim: An open import `import Ranges` makes any use of `between` a ScopeConflict error.

cases.name: between-open-control
cases.claim: Control: the same open import compiles when `between` is not used (with the compiler's ImplicitImport warning for each of the two open imports).

cases.name: abs-not-in-prelude
cases.claim: With only `import Prelude`, `abs` is "Unknown value abs".

cases.name: abs-from-data-ord
cases.claim: `abs` and `signum` are in `Data.Ord`.

cases.name: no-tuple-syntax
cases.claim: There is no tuple syntax: `(a, b)` fails to parse with "Unexpected token ','".

cases.name: no-tuple-syntax-control
cases.claim: Control: a pair is `Tuple a b` from `Data.Tuple`.

cases.name: number-add-nonassoc
cases.claim: Addition on `Number` is not associative: in 100,000 fixed-seed triples, about a quarter differ when the values are uniform on [0, m) for m from 1 to 1e9; with values uniform on [-m, m) the share is under a tenth at m = 1 and about a third at larger m.

cases.name: quickcheck-chain
cases.claim: `===` and `<?>` are both infix 2, so `x === y <?> "msg"` fails with NonAssociativeError.

cases.name: quickcheck-types
cases.claim: Nor do they compose by type: `===` returns a Result and `<?>` takes a Boolean.

cases.name: quickcheck-types-control
cases.claim: Control: `(x == y) <?> "msg"` compiles.

cases.name: bigints-npm
cases.claim: `Data.BigInt` from `bigints` imports the npm package `big-integer`; without it the program fails at runtime with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

cases.name: js-bigints-native
cases.claim: `JS.BigInt` from `js-bigints` has no npm dependency.

cases.name: laws-gen-variant
cases.claim: quickcheck-laws has `checkSemigroupGen :: Gen s -> Effect Unit`.

cases.name: laws-proxy-needs-arbitrary
cases.claim: `checkSemigroup` takes a Proxy and needs an `Arbitrary s` instance.

cases.name: laws-proxy-needs-arbitrary-control
cases.claim: Control: with an `Arbitrary` instance, `checkSemigroup` compiles.

cases.name: arbitrary-number-uniform
cases.claim: `Arbitrary Number` is `uniform`, values in [0.0, 1.0). A sample supports this; it cannot prove it.

cases.name: hole-one-decl
cases.claim: Holes in the same declaration are reported together.

cases.name: hole-two-decls
cases.claim: Holes in separate declarations appear one compile at a time.
